title: Presentation data for normalized reindexing coherence
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension in universe $u$, and let $s\in\operatorname{Option}(\mathbf N)$. For every scheme $W$ in universe $u$, use the coefficient ring sheaf $(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1})_W$ if $s=\mathrm{some}(n)$ and the ordinary completed ring sheaf $\varprojlim_n(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1})_W$ if $s=\mathrm{none}$ [lem-pod-reindexing-hom-resolution-model]. Its pro-etale site has object universe $u+1$ and arrow universe $u$; modules have universe $u+1$ and the ordinary unbounded derived category has localization universe $u+2$. Write $K_W$ for the cochain category, total for its actual total tensor, hom for its product Hom complex and proj for its product projection. Closed and Models denote a closed structure for the recorded derived Hom and its normalized K-flat tensor model [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. For schemes $X,Y,Z$ with pro-etale sites essentially small in universe $u+1$, isomorphisms $g:X\to Y$, $h:Z\to X$, and chosen Closed and Models on these schemes, define the following presentations. Comparison$(g)$ consists of an isomorphism on all actual Hom complexes, fixed on every slice-Hom product projection; the natural derived Hom isomorphism fixed by its K-injective localization model; the total-tensor chain isomorphism fixed on every sheafified pure summand; and the natural derived tensor isomorphism fixed on K-flat pairs. EvaluationLaws records its evaluation equation, uniqueness among all arrows, transported transposition, and both variances. For arbitrary integers $a,b,r$, ChainShift records the Hom double-shift isomorphism with component $(-1)^{ar}$ and the shift reindexing; ShiftLaws records the chain square and its localization using signedShift, which first applies the source shift and then the target shift [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction]. The auxiliary complexShift is the termwise shift comparison. Compositor$(g,h)$ and Identity$(X)$ are ordinary, termwise and derived reindexing identifications fixed by the site restriction maps siteComp$(g,h)$ and siteId$(X)$ and localization. These are the pre-existing presentation structures of the parent, moved verbatim, and assert no existence or coherence theorem.
